title: Change an Employee's Manager
goal: Move one employee to a new manager, on the right date, and tell the people affected.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 3/2/26, Alex Enferadi). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the pay type check, the 'tell the new manager' step and the call with the outgoing manager describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.instruction: Search for the employee from Home.
steps.where: The search box on the Home page.
steps.expect: The employee shows in the results.
steps.why: Right person first. Everything else depends on it.
hints: Similar names are the top mistake. Match the person number.

steps.title: Open Change Manager
steps.instruction: Click the arrow by their name. Choose Change Manager.
steps.where: The small arrow right of their name in the results.
steps.expect: Change Manager opens on Info to Include.

commonMistakes.say: Not Change Location. That moves where they work.
Not Change Assignment. That's for job, grade or department.

steps.title: Skip Info to Include
steps.where: Continue, at the bottom of Info to Include.
steps.expect: You see: When does the manager change start?

check.question: What do you change on Info to Include?
check.why: Leave it as it is and continue.

steps.title: Check the pay type
steps.instruction: Is the employee exempt or non-exempt?
steps.why: It decides which start dates you can use.

steps.title: Set the start date
steps.where: The first field: When does the manager change start?
steps.expect: The date shows in the field.
hints: Non-exempt? Pick the Sunday that starts the pay period.

steps.title: Pick the way and reason
steps.instruction: Way: Manager Change. Reason: Change Line Manager. Then Continue.
steps.where: The two drop-downs under the date. Continue is at the bottom.
steps.why: The reason is what reporting and audit see.
hints: Don't swap them. Manager Change is the way, not the reason.

check.question: Which one is the reason?
check.why: Reason: Change Line Manager. Way: Manager Change.

steps.title: Swap in the new manager
steps.instruction: Click the pencil on the current manager. Pick the new one from the list. Save.
steps.where: The pencil at the right end of the manager's row.
steps.expect: The row shows the new manager.
steps.why: Picking from the list links the right person.
hints: Two similar names? Check title or department.

steps.title: Submit
steps.why: Save isn't enough. Nothing changes until you submit.

check.question: Your edit is saved. Is the change done?
options: No. I still need to Submit.
check.why: Save only keeps your edit. Submit makes the change.

steps.title: Tell the new manager
steps.instruction: Tell them it's done and when it starts.
steps.why: Approvals go to them from that date. Don't let it be a surprise.
steps.confirm: I let the new manager know

steps.title: Hand off with the outgoing manager
steps.instruction: Call to hand off anything still open.

prep.goal: Agree who handles open approvals for this employee up to the effective date.
prep.opener: Hi, quick one. The manager change is submitted and I want to make sure nothing open gets stranded before it takes effect.

pushbacks.if: I was not told about this change
pushbacks.try: Stay factual: say who requested it and the date, and offer to connect them with the requester today.

pushbacks.if: I still have timecards to approve
pushbacks.try: Agree a cut-off: they approve everything dated before the effective date, the new manager takes it from there.

doThis: Say the effective date in your first two sentences.
Ask what is still open for this employee.
End with who does what by when.

callouts.say: For non-exempt employees, the effective date must be the first day of the pay period, which is a Sunday.
callouts.source: Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 3/2/26

callouts.say: Manager changes are approved automatically in Oracle. A confirmation notification is sent shortly after you submit.
callouts.source: Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 3/2/26

reminders.say: Check that the confirmation notification arrived and the new manager shows on the employee's record.

recap.summary: You moved the employee to a new manager, on a safe start date, and told the people affected.
